newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in late trading on Monday as stronger-than-expected economic reports made investors nervous about a possible resurgence of inflation.
At 3:55 p.m. EDT/1955 GMT, the Dow was off 51 points at 7,280, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
